item.title: German industry has lost nearly half a million jobs since 2019, Ifo says
item.description: German industry has shed nearly half a million jobs since 2019, an Ifo study showed on Monday, as manufacturers grapple with mounting competitive pressure.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: German industry has shed nearly half a million jobs since 2019, an Ifo study showed on Monday, as manufacturers grapple with mounting competitive pressure. Here are some key points: At the end of 2025, 496,000 fewer people were working than at the start of 2019, a drop of 7.1%. In the service sector, more than 2.2 million jobs were created, primarily in health and social services, and in public administration. "Germany is undergoing an accelerated structural shift. Ironically, the very sectors that have sustained our prosperity up to now are shrinking," said Joachim Ragnitz, managing director at Ifo. "The new jobs are for the most part not being created where Germany is especially productive and innovative. That may slow down our growth potential in the future," Ragnitz said. Employment is shrinking in almost all industrial sectors, which is likely a result of declining competitiveness, particularly against China, the study said. The automotive industry and its suppliers cut 123,500 jobs, a drop of 13%, manufacturers of metal products cut 115,600 jobs, while 64,500 were cut in mechanical engineering. These three sectors account for around 60% of the cuts, according to Ragnitz's calculations.

item.title: Roche moves future Germany investments 'on hold'
item.description: Swiss drugmaker Roche is reviewing all future investments in Germany over healthcare cost-cutting policies, the company's Germany chief said in an interview with newspaper Welt that was published on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Swiss drugmaker Roche (ROPC.S) is reviewing all future investments in Germany over healthcare cost-cutting policies, the company's Germany chief said in an interview with newspaper Welt that was published on Monday. "We have put all future investment decisions in Germany on hold for the time being," said Daniel Steiners, head of Roche Germany, adding that for the pharmaceutical industry, policy makers had "recently destroyed a lot of trust". Steiners said that instead of tackling the structural problems of the statutory health insurance system, policy makers are focusing on short-term savings and placing additional burdens on the industry A so-called ‘location clause’, which could exempt domestically producing pharmaceutical companies from manufacturer discounts, would only partially offset the negative effects of the legislation, needed is a comprehensive strategy, he added Following proposed legislation in Germany to cap rapidly growing costs in the statutory health insurance system, Eli Lilly (LLY.N) had in June already said it would [USN:L8N42N1BQ TEXT:"halve"] its planned €2.3 billion ($2.57 billion) investments in the country Planned investments like the more than €600 million expansion of the site in Penzberg, Bavaria, are not impacted by the reviews, a company spokesperson told Reuters ($1 = 0.8934 euros)

item.title: Gulf bourses subdued as regional worries weigh
item.description: Major Gulf stock markets were subdued in early trade on Monday as tensions in the Middle East kept investors on edge, with a tanker blast in the Strait of Hormuz and uncertainty over the waterway's reopening adding to the caution.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Major Gulf stock markets were subdued in early trade on Monday as tensions in the Middle East kept investors on edge, with a tanker blast in the Strait of Hormuz and uncertainty over the waterway's reopening adding to the caution. An oil tanker [USN:S8N44Y01I TEXT:"caught fire and exploded after striking a naval mine"] in the southern part of the strait, Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps navy said on Sunday, according to Iranian media. Separately, Foreign Minister Abbas Araqchi [USN:L1N46401N TEXT:"told Iranian media"] that Tehran's offer to the United States to reopen the strait within seven days was still on the table. Brent crude futures fell 2.08% to $107.57 a barrel by 0619 GMT after settling at their highest since May 19 on Friday, as investors took profits after US President Donald Trump waived sanctions and tariffs on Russia, a move that may lead to more Russian fuel exports. Saudi Arabia's benchmark index (.TASI) fell 0.3%, hit by a 1.7% drop in Saudi Arabian Mining Co (1211.SE) and a 0.8% decline in the country's biggest lender by assets, Saudi National Bank (1180.SE) . Among other losers, oil behemoth Saudi Aramco (2222.SE) was down 0.3%. Dubai's main share index (.DFMGI) was flat, though Dubai Investments (DINV.DU) advanced 2.4%. The group [USN:L6N4650BU TEXT:"plans to float a 20% stake in subsidiary DIP Holding"], owner of the Dubai Investments Park real estate business, in the UAE's first initial public offering this year and one of only a few in the Gulf amid the Iran war. In Abu Dhabi, the index (.FTFADGI) eased 0.2%, while the Qatari index (.QSI) lost 0.5% to trade at its lowest in more than six years.

item.description:
Mayu Sakoda
[東京 １９日 ロイター] - 投資運用会社のありあけキャピタル（東京都中央区）が愛媛銀行...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ありあけキャピタル、愛媛銀株を大量保有　いよぎんＨＤとの統合控え 17:08 配信

Mayu Sakoda

[東京 １９日 ロイター] - 投資運用会社のありあけキャピタル（東京都中央区）が愛媛銀行株を５．１９％保有していることが１９日提出の大量保有報告書で分かった。報告義務発生日は９日。

ありあけキャピタルは保有目的として「純投資を基本とする」とし、その上で愛媛銀が基本合意したいよぎんホールディングスとの経営統合について、企業価値向上および株主共同の利益確保の観点から経営陣との対話・助言を行っていると説明している。具体的には統合条件の考え方、船舶ファイナンス事業の集中リスクの管理、成長戦略、資本政策などについて建設的な対話を継続する方針としている。

愛媛銀といよぎんＨＤは２０２６年１２月に最終契約および株式交換契約を締結し、２０２７年２月に愛媛銀の臨時株主総会を開く予定。

item.title: Don Wilson on the GPU Market's Trillion Dollar Question
item.description: When we spoke to Don Wilson, founder and CEO of DRW, in Chicago last year, he told us he wanted to build a market for GPUs that would eventually be bigger than oil. A year's time in the age of AI is an eternity, and so for the first episode of this year's Chicago live show - recorded at City Winery - Wilson joins us on stage again to talk about what's changed and what hasn't in his quest to help build this market. We get his take on the recent tech selloff, including credit concerns around neocloud CoreWeave. And we also discuss how DRW is developing a “crunch spread” (the GPU version of a crack spread), the latest on his plans to launch GPU futures, and the possibility of token futures too. (Source: Bloomberg)

FAST

SEOUL: The leader of the South Korean religious sect Jesus Morning Star was sentenced on Monday (Oct 19) to a further 33 years in jail after being found guilty of sexually assaulting and abusing female followers. Jung Myung-seok, believed to be in his early 80s, is currently serving a 17-year sentence after being convicted of separate sexual assaults of followers. Those assaults occurred after he was released from prison following a 2008 rape conviction. In this latest case, Jung - who was featured in a Netflix documentary series In the Name of God: A Holy Betrayal about four South Korean religious leaders accused of various crimes - was accused of sexually assaulting and abusing 16 female followers for several years through 2022. Jung would serve the 33-year term after the earlier sentence, a Daejeon court official said. An official at the sect's mission office in South Chungcheong province did not have immediate comment on whether Jung would appeal the ruling. Another sect official was sentenced to seven years in prison for abetting Jung's actions, the official said.

Source: Reuters/ec

item.title: Gewinnplus stärkt Bawag den Rücken für Zukauf in Irland
item.description: Ein kräftiger Gewinnsprung im dritten Quartal stärkt der österreichischen Bank Bawag den Rücken für die geplante Übernahme des irischen Geldhauses Permanent TSB (PTSB). Der Nettogewinn kletterte von Juli bis September im Jahresvergleich um 13 Prozent auf 248 Millionen Euro, wie die Bawag am Montag mitteilte. Der Nettozinsertrag stieg um acht Prozent auf 497 Millionen Euro, angetrieben von einer positiven Entwicklung im Geschäft mit Privat- und kleinen Firmenkunden. Die operativen Aufwendungen sanken unterdessen dank realisierter Synergien und Effizienzsteigerungen um zehn Prozent. Für das Gesamtjahr 2026 bekräftigte die Bank ihr Ziel eines Nettogewinns von mehr als 960 Millionen Euro.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Ein kräftiger Gewinnsprung im dritten Quartal stärkt der österreichischen Bank Bawag (BAWG.VI) den Rücken für die geplante Übernahme des irischen Geldhauses Permanent TSB (PTSB) (PTSB.I) . Der Nettogewinn kletterte von Juli bis September im Jahresvergleich um 13 Prozent auf 248 Millionen Euro, wie die Bawag am Montag mitteilte. Der Nettozinsertrag stieg um acht Prozent auf 497 Millionen Euro, angetrieben von einer positiven Entwicklung im Geschäft mit Privat- und kleinen Firmenkunden. Die operativen Aufwendungen sanken unterdessen dank realisierter Synergien und Effizienzsteigerungen um zehn Prozent. Für das Gesamtjahr 2026 bekräftigte die Bank ihr Ziel eines Nettogewinns von mehr als 960 Millionen Euro. Die starken Zahlen konnten der Bawag-Aktie jedoch keinen Auftrieb geben: Sie gab an der Wiener Börse um 2,7 Prozent auf 163,80 Euro nach. Die Ergebnisse entsprachen Analysten zufolge weitgehend den Erwartungen. Die Profitabilität des Instituts verbesserte sich im dritten Quartal deutlich. Die Kosten-Ertrags-Relation (CIR) sank auf 29,8 Prozent, nach 33,2 Prozent im Vorjahreszeitraum. Die Risikovorsorge stieg auf 79 Millionen Euro, nach 45 Millionen Euro im Vorjahr, und lag damit über den Erwartungen von Analysten. Die Bank begründete den Anstieg mit der strategischen Verschiebung hin zu margenstärkeren Krediten im Privat- und Firmenkundengeschäft. Die Kreditqualität sei mit einer Quote notleidender Kredite (NPL) von 1,0 Prozent für den Gesamtkonzern weiterhin stark. Zudem nahm die Bawag die Rückstellungen für die Dividende wieder auf, was von Analysten als positives Signal für die operative Leistung gewertet wurde. STARKE ZAHLEN ALS RÜCKENDECKUNG FÜR MILLIARDEN-DEAL Mit einer harten Kernkapitalquote (CET1) von 17,1 Prozent sei die Bawag gut positioniert, die 1,6 Milliarden Euro schwere Übernahme der PTSB eigenständig zu finanzieren, hieß es. "Wir bereiten uns auf die geplante Übernahme von PTSB und die nächste Entwicklungsphase als paneuropäische und US-Bankengruppe vor", sagte Vorstandschef Anas Abuzaakouk. Nach Ansicht von Analysten dürften die Unsicherheiten rund um die geplante Übernahme der irischen Bank die Aktie zuletzt belastet haben. Berichte über zwei mögliche Gegenangebote für die PTSB sorgten für Verunsicherung bei den Anlegern. Mit Axis Capital und Scotchstone Capital haben zwei Finanzinvestoren Interesse an der PTSB bekundet und prüfen Gegenangebote. Axis Capital lockt dabei mit einem Preis von 3,20 Euro je Aktie, der über dem Bawag-Angebot von 2,97 Euro liegt. Die PTSB hält jedoch an der Vereinbarung mit der Bawag fest und wies die Vorstöße als "hochgradig spekulativ" zurück. Unterstützung erhält die PTSB dabei vom irischen Staat, der als Großaktionär den Deal ebenfalls befürwortet. Die Aktionäre der irischen Bank hatten dem Verkauf an die Bawag bereits im Juli zugestimmt. Die endgültige Entscheidung des irischen High Court über die Genehmigung wird für den 27. Oktober erwartet. Der Abschluss der Transaktion soll im vierten Quartal 2026 oder im ersten Quartal 2027 erfolgen.

item.description: Las fuerzas armadas de Malí y sus aliados rusos han recurrido a ataques con drones "aparentemente indiscriminados" y a otros abusos como parte de una ofensiva intensificada contra los insurgentes en los últimos meses, que han causado la muerte de decenas de civiles, señaló Human Rights Watch en un informe publicado este lunes.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Las fuerzas armadas de Malí y sus aliados rusos han recurrido a ataques con drones "aparentemente indiscriminados" y a otros abusos como parte de una ofensiva intensificada contra los insurgentes en los últimos meses, que han causado la muerte de decenas de civiles, señaló Human Rights Watch en un informe publicado este lunes. Los ataques con drones y las víctimas civiles resultantes se duplicaron con creces entre abril y agosto, en comparación con el mismo periodo del año anterior, según el informe, que basa su información en datos de ACLED, en respuesta a los ataques a escala nacional perpetrados por la filial regional de Al Qaeda, conocida como JNIM, y por los separatistas liderados por los tuaregs. Los ataques insurgentes lanzados el 25 de abril causaron la muerte del ministro de Defensa de Malí y afectaron a múltiples pueblos y ciudades, así como al principal aeropuerto de Bamako, lo que pone de relieve las dificultades del Gobierno para mejorar la seguridad en este país sin litoral de África Occidental. Los líderes militares de Malí, que tomaron el poder mediante golpes de Estado en 2020 y 2021, han recurrido a Rusia en busca de apoyo en su lucha contra los insurgentes, y han contratado al grupo paramilitar ruso "Africa Corps" para responder a los ataques de abril. Los datos del observatorio de conflictos ACLED, con sede en Estados Unidos, revelaron que las fuerzas malienses y el "Africa Corps" llevaron a cabo 47 ataques con drones que causaron 94 muertes de civiles entre abril y agosto, frente a los 22 ataques que provocaron 44 muertes de civiles un año antes. LOS ATAQUES DAÑARON UN MERCADO DE GANADO Y UN CENTRO DE SALUD, SEGÚN EL INFORME Algunos de los incidentes recogidos en el informe fueron "aparentes ataques indiscriminados con drones", entre ellos un ataque perpetrado el 19 de agosto contra un mercado de ganado en la región de Bandiagara, en el centro de Malí, que causó la muerte de seis hombres, y un ataque perpetrado antes del amanecer del 29 de julio contra un centro de salud en la región septentrional de Kidal, cerca de la frontera con Argelia, señaló Human Rights Watch. El informe también documentó abusos en los que no intervinieron drones, incluido un incidente ocurrido el 12 de julio en la región de Segú, en el que, según el informe, unos soldados dispararon y mataron a cinco jóvenes a las que confundieron con atacantes. Un portavoz del ejército maliense no respondió a una solicitud de comentarios. Human Rights Watch señaló que no recibió respuesta a una carta enviada el 5 de agosto al nuevo ministro de Defensa de Malí en la que se detallaban las conclusiones de la organización. Malí ha negado anteriormente haber matado a civiles en operaciones de contrainsurgencia. La embajada rusa en Bamako no respondió de inmediato a una solicitud de comentarios sobre la participación del "Africa Corps". El informe de Human Rights Watch también documentó abusos cometidos por el JNIM y los separatistas liderados por los tuaregs, incluida la ejecución de 19 soldados en la región septentrional de Gao en julio. El Comité de la Sharia del JNIM dijo a HRW que los asesinatos "sí que se produjeron", pero negó haberlos ordenado y dijo que "no es nuestra política hacer ese tipo de cosas". El Frente de Liberación de Azawad, liderado por los tuaregs, negó haber ejecutado a soldados.

item.title: 米国務長官、米がウクライナとの情報共有を一時停止した事実を否定
item.description:
Gram Slattery
[サマルカンド １９日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Gram Slattery

[サマルカンド １９日 ロイター] - ルビオ米国務長官は１９日、米国がウクライナとの情報共有の一部を一時停止した事実を否定した。これは、ウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領の発言と矛盾する。

ゼレンスキー氏は１８日、ＮＢＣの『ミート・ザ・プレス』に出演した際、米国との情報共有が一時中断されたが、その後「再開された」と発言。「今は正常に機能している」と述べていた。

だが、ウズベキスタン訪問中のルビオ氏は１９日、実際には情報共有が中断されたことはなかったと説明。記者団に対し、「ゼレンスキー氏がどこからそのような情報を得ているのか、なぜ報道陣にそのような発言をしているのかは分からない。直接聞いてみてほしい。中断など一度もなかった」と語った。

その上で「ゼレンスキー氏が注力すべきこと、そしてわれわれが注力したいことは、この戦争に終止符を打つことだ」と語った。

ウクライナは、ロシアが同国の都市に向けて波状攻撃で発射している高速弾道ミサイルを検知するために、米国の情報に依存してきた。

トランプ米大統領は、米国が依然として情報を共有していると述べていたが、ウクライナ当局者は、ロシアによる攻撃の一部が警告なしに行われたと指摘しており、情報が実際に通常通り提供されているのかどうか疑問が投げかけられている。

item.title: Un ataque ruso mata a una mujer y alcanza una estación de metro en Kiev, según el alcalde
item.description: Un ataque aéreo ruso mató a una mujer durante la noche en Kiev, alcanzó una estación de metro en la capital ucraniana y dañó un edificio residencial de 25 plantas, informó el alcalde, Vitali Klichkó, el lunes en Telegram.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Un ataque aéreo ruso mató a una mujer durante la noche en Kiev, alcanzó una estación de metro en la capital ucraniana y dañó un edificio residencial de 25 plantas, informó el alcalde, Vitali Klichkó, el lunes en Telegram. El ataque, que también alcanzó edificios no residenciales y un centro médico, dejó otros tres heridos en Kiev, dijo. Un testigo de Reuters oyó explosiones en la ciudad. Tras una breve pausa, Estados Unidos ha reanudado el intercambio de información de inteligencia crucial para ayudar a Ucrania a defenderse de los ataques con misiles rusos, afirmó el presidente Volodímir Zelenski. Esa información es clave para alertar de la llegada de los veloces misiles que Moscú ha lanzado en oleadas. Zelenski habló con los enviados estadounidenses para la paz Steve Witkoff y Jared Kushner después de que ambos visitaran Kiev a principios de este mes, mientras el Gobierno estadounidense intenta mediar en un acuerdo para poner fin a la guerra que Rusia inició al invadir a su vecino en 2022.

item.title: China commerce ministry announces export controls for tunnel boring machines
item.description: China's commerce ministry said on Monday it would set export controls on tunnel boring machines, a key piece of equipment for construction.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: China's commerce ministry said on Monday it would set export controls on tunnel boring machines, a key piece of equipment for construction. China exported about $793 million in self-propelled coal or rock cutters and tunnelling machinery in 2025, according to UN Comtrade data. It is among the [USN:L4N43W1ZD TEXT:"key suppliers"] of tunnelling and other boring equipment used in metro rail and highway construction. China's commerce ministry said export operators would need to apply for a license in accordance with provisions of export control law and regulations on the export control of dual-use items. The restrictions go into effect on November 18. It also said it would adjust export control measures for drone-related items and dredgers, part of updates to the country's dual-use items exports list.

item.title: Wary of instability, China calls for deeper security cooperation with Tajikistan
item.description: China's Premier Li Qiang called on Monday for deeper security and intelligence cooperation with Tajikistan to fight what Beijing views as extremism and separatism, and said he hoped the country would take "strong measures" to protect Chinese citizens.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: China's Premier Li Qiang called on Monday for deeper security and intelligence cooperation with Tajikistan to fight what Beijing views as extremism and separatism, and said he hoped the country would take "strong measures" to protect Chinese citizens. China has long feared violence in Central Asia could spill over into its far western region of Xinjiang, home to the mostly Muslim Uyghur people. China says Uyghur militants were behind a string of past attacks in Xinjiang. Li told Tajik President Emomali Rahmon that the two countries should deepen cooperation on law enforcement and security, and strengthen intelligence exchanges and sharing, China's official Xinhua news agency said. China and Tajikistan should jointly fight the "three evil forces" — a term Beijing uses to describe terrorism, separatism, and extremism — and safeguard regional peace and stability, Li added. Human rights groups say China has [USN:FWN3071Q6 TEXT:"severely repressed"] the Uyghur people and curtailed their religious, cultural and linguistic rights. China denies any abuses have taken place. Li is not the only high-profile foreign official visiting resource-rich Central Asia this week, with US Secretary of State Marco Rubio travelling on Sunday to [USN:L1N46404L TEXT:"Uzbekistan"]. Li was in Uzbekistan before going to Tajikistan. China, which has a remote, mountainous border with Tajikistan, is a major investor in the country. Late last year, five Chinese nationals were killed in [USN:L8N3X70LX TEXT:"Tajikistan"] in attacks the authorities said were launched from neighbouring Afghanistan. Tajikistan, a former Soviet republic of around 11 million people with a secular government, has tense relations with the Taliban authorities in Afghanistan. It has previously warned of drug smugglers and illicit gold miners working along the frontier. Tajikistan endured a brutal civil war in the 1990s after the Soviet Union broke apart, during which Rahmon initially rose to power. The country is closely aligned with Russia, which maintains a military base there.

item.title: 中国・香港株式市場・大引け＝銀行主導で上昇、香港休場
item.description: [上海 １９日 ロイター] - 中国株式市場は銀行株主導で上昇して引けた。好調な第３・四半期の国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）統計...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
中国・香港株式市場・大引け＝銀行主導で上昇、香港休場 16:48 配信

[上海 １９日 ロイター] - 中国株式市場は銀行株主導で上昇して引けた。好調な第３・四半期の国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）統計が、人工知能（ＡＩ）サプライチェーン関連の一部企業を巡る軟調なセンチメントを上回った。

香港市場は祝日のため休場で、取引は２０日に再開する。

中国の主要指数ＣＳＩ３００指数は０．１％高、上海総合指数は０．４％高で終了した。

中国の第３・四半期国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）は前年同期比４．５％増と、予想を上回った。これにより、年間成長率目標を達成するために政府が支援策を強化する緊急性は低下した。９月の小売売上高も伸びが加速した。

ＡＮＺはリポートで「９月の指標は予想外に良かったものの、２０２６年１─９月の実績を見れば、中国経済の不均衡に対する国内外の懸念はやはり強まった」と指摘。「バランスシート不況の圧力がかかる中、政策上の制約で金融緩和には限界があり、財政支援が引き続き極めて重要だ」とした。

銀行や酒類など伝統的なセクターが本土市場の上昇を主導し、それぞれ１．５％高、０．８％高となった。

ハイテク株中心の上海証券取引所の新興ハイテク企業向け市場「科創板」５０指数は２．２％下落。ＡＩチップのサプライチェーンを巡るセンチメントは引き続き軟調だった。

上場来安値を付けた人型ロボットメーカーのユニツリー（宇樹科技）は１６％急騰。一方、メモリー半導体メーカーの長鑫科技集団（ＣＸＭＴ）は７．８％下落した。

投資家の関心は、１９日午後に北京で開かれる重要な金融フォーラムに移っている。このフォーラムでは中国証券監督管理委員会（証監会）高官が講演する予定だ。

ロイター 関連ニュース 焦点：中国株、ＧＤＰ発表後も買い不発　不動産低迷で慎重ムード コラム：中国の緩和シグナルに一抹の警戒心、経済再構築は待ったなし コラム：海外マネーの中国離れ、習主席はじっとやり過ごすのが得策か アングル：中国ユニツリー、上場後に株価急落　バブルやＩＰＯ制度に懸念 焦点：中国地方経済の二極化鮮明、ハイテク拠点が成長けん引　伝統産業依存は低迷 最終更新: 10/19(月) 16:48 ロイター

item.title: Rheinmetall, MSC jointly acquire Romanian shipyard
item.description: German defence group Rheinmetall and Swiss-based shipping company MSC have acquired Romanian shipyard Mangalia for €138 million ($155 million) and aim to develop it for both civilian and military shipbuilding, Rheinmetall said on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: German defence group Rheinmetall (RHMG.DE) and Swiss-based shipping company MSC have acquired Romanian shipyard Mangalia for €138 million ($155 million) and aim to develop it for both civilian and military shipbuilding, Rheinmetall said on Monday. Here are some more details from Rheinmetall's statement : Rheinmetall and MSC have been awarded the bid following an auction. The shipyard, located on the Black Sea coast, will be divided into sectors and security zones. For Rheinmetall, Mangalia will play an important role in building four naval vessels, which have been commissioned by Romania. The site is intended to serve as a hub for further military shipbuilding projects. "In doing so, Rheinmetall is creating a scalable foundation for future projects in southeastern Europe and strengthens its position in a strategically important market," Rheinmetall said. ($1 = €0.8916)

item.title: Shastri urges India to use Bumrah sparingly ahead of ODI World Cup
item.description: India should keep Jasprit Bumrah fresh for next year's one-day international World Cup by selecting him mainly for test cricket and using the pace spearhead sparingly in other formats, former coach Ravi Shastri said.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: India should keep Jasprit Bumrah fresh for next year's one-day international World Cup by selecting him mainly for test cricket and using the pace spearhead sparingly in other formats, former coach Ravi Shastri said. Bumrah was [USN:L4N4621F5 TEXT:"recalled"] to India's test squad for their two-match series in New Zealand last week, but will not play in the five ODIs and five Twenty20 internationals that precede the tests. Bumrah's career has been disrupted by back injuries, with the 32-year-old having to undergo surgery in 2023. He was ruled out of a two-test series against Sri Lanka in August due to a left knee injury, but returned to T20 action at the Asian Games and [USN:L6N45P00U TEXT:"helped India win gold"]. "I don't think he should play all three formats till the ODI World Cup," Shastri, who coached India from 2017 to 2021, told Indian media on Sunday. "He should play test cricket and should play sporadically between one-day internationals and T20 cricket. He also shouldn't be playing the whole lot. "I would rather preserve him for the test matches. That's very important. He becomes a key member of that Indian side. Then he should be used sparingly in the other formats." Following their tour of New Zealand, India will host Sri Lanka and Zimbabwe in limited-overs series, before hosting Australia in a five-test series which concludes in February. The 2027 World Cup will be held in South Africa, Zimbabwe and Namibia from October 2 to November 21.

item.title: Roche legt künftige Investitionen in Deutschland auf Eis
item.description: Der Schweizer Pharmakonzern Roche stellt wegen der Sparpolitik der Bundesregierung im Gesundheitswesen alle künftigen Investitionen in Deutschland vorerst auf den Prüfstand. "Wir haben sämtliche künftigen Investitionsentscheidungen in Deutschland erst einmal auf Hold gesetzt", sagte Roche-Deutschlandchef Daniel Steiners der Zeitung "Welt" (Montagausgabe). "Für den Pharmabereich kann ich sagen, dass die Politik zuletzt sehr viel Vertrauen zerstört hat." Bereits getroffene Entscheidungen, wie der mehr als 600 Millionen Euro teure Ausbau des bayerischen Standorts Penzberg, seien davon jedoch nicht betroffen, sagte eine Sprecherin der Nachrichtenagentur Reuters.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Der Schweizer Pharmakonzern Roche stellt wegen der Sparpolitik der Bundesregierung im Gesundheitswesen alle künftigen Investitionen in Deutschland vorerst auf den Prüfstand. "Wir haben sämtliche künftigen Investitionsentscheidungen in Deutschland erst einmal auf Hold gesetzt", sagte Roche-Deutschlandchef Daniel Steiners der Zeitung "Welt" (Montagausgabe). "Für den Pharmabereich kann ich sagen, dass die Politik zuletzt sehr viel Vertrauen zerstört hat." Bereits getroffene Entscheidungen, wie der mehr als 600 Millionen Euro teure Ausbau des bayerischen Standorts [USN:L8N42H0E6 TEXT:"Penzberg"], seien davon jedoch nicht betroffen, sagte eine Sprecherin der Nachrichtenagentur Reuters. Steiners forderte verlässliche Rahmenbedingungen. Mit Blick auf das Gesetz zur Stabilisierung der Krankenkassenbeiträge (GKV) sagte er: "Statt die strukturellen Probleme der GKV anzugehen, setzt die Politik auf kurzfristige Einsparungen und zusätzliche Belastungen für die Industrie." Die geplante Standortklausel zur Entlastung forschender und produzierender Pharmaunternehmen bei den Herstellerrabatten könne die negativen Folgen des Gesetzes nur teilweise abfedern. Nötig sei eine umfassende Strategie. Steiners lobte zudem die USA für ihre Industriepolitik. "Europa sollte vor allem lernen, sich wieder anzustrengen", erklärte der Manager. Die Sparpläne der Bundesregierung sorgten in der Pharmabranche zuletzt für erhebliche Unruhe. Der US-Konzern Eli Lilly (LLY.N) kündigte im Sommer an, seine geplanten Investitionen in Deutschland von 2,3 Milliarden Euro zu halbieren. Boehringer Ingelheim strich geplante Ausgaben von 900 Millionen Euro komplett. Roche beschäftigt in Deutschland rund 18.000 Mitarbeiter. Der Konzern aus Basel investierte nach eigenen Angaben seit 2020 hierzulande fast 3,8 Milliarden Euro.

item.title: Streit um UBS-Kapitalregeln: Schweizer Parlament im Dilemma
item.description: Schweizer Parlamentsabgeordnete stehen bei der Ausarbeitung neuer Kapitalvorschriften für die Großbank UBS vor einer schwierigen Entscheidung. Nach dem Zusammenbruch der Credit Suisse im Jahr 2023 muss das Parlament über strengere Regeln entscheiden. Setzen die Abgeordneten die Hürden zu hoch an, könnte die größte Bank des Landes eine Abwanderung ins Ausland ins Auge fassen. Fallen die Regeln jedoch zu mild aus, könnte ein Referendum die Reform blockieren und die Unsicherheit verlängern.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Schweizer Parlamentsabgeordnete stehen bei der Ausarbeitung neuer Kapitalvorschriften für die Großbank UBS (UBSG.S) vor einer schwierigen Entscheidung. Nach dem Zusammenbruch der Credit Suisse im Jahr 2023 muss das Parlament über strengere Regeln entscheiden. Setzen die Abgeordneten die Hürden zu hoch an, könnte die größte Bank des Landes eine Abwanderung ins Ausland ins Auge fassen. Fallen die Regeln jedoch zu mild aus, könnte ein Referendum die Reform blockieren und die Unsicherheit verlängern. Ein Ausschuss des Nationalrats, der großen Kammer des Parlaments, beginnt am 26. Oktober mit der Beratung über die Gesetzesvorlage. Der Ständerat, die kleine Kammer des Parlaments, hatte im September beschlossen, dass die UBS ihre ausländischen Tochtergesellschaften mit [USN:L8N45F0OZ TEXT:"90 Prozent"] hartem Kernkapital (CET1) absichern muss. Bislang liegt diese Quote bei 60 Prozent, wobei ein Teil der Mittel durch günstigere sogenannte AT1-Anleihen gedeckt werden kann. Die Schweizer Regierung hat 100 Prozent vorgeschlagen. Die Sozialdemokratische Partei droht mit einer Volksabstimmung, falls dieser 100-Prozent-Vorschlag zu stark verwässert wird. Die UBS bezeichnete bereits den Vorschlag von 90 Prozent Kernkapital als überzogen und warnte vor Einbußen bei der Wettbewerbsfähigkeit. Großaktionäre wie Artisan Partners forderten die Bank öffentlich auf, die Schweiz wegen der drohenden Regulierung zu verlassen. Das Parlament befinde sich in einer verzwickten Lage, sagte Leo Müller, Ausschussmitglied und Nationalrat der Mitte-Partei. Wenn die Vorlage zu sehr verwässert werde, drohe eine Volksabstimmung. Dann bestehe das Risiko, dass die Bevölkerung die Reform ablehne. "Wenn wir zu streng sind, könnte die Bank sagen, dass die Schweiz ein schwieriger Wirtschaftsstandort geworden ist, und sich anderweitig umsehen." Hans-Peter Portmann von der liberalen FDP hat eine Anforderung von 75 Prozent hartem Eigenkapital für die Auslandseinheiten der UBS ins Spiel gebracht. Dies soll mit einem Mechanismus kombiniert werden, der die verlustabsorbierende Kapazität der Bank stärkt, falls die Kapitalquoten unter einen bestimmten Wert fallen. Vor der für Dezember erwarteten Debatte im Nationalrat dürften noch weitere Vorschläge auftauchen. "EIN KLEINES LAND FÜR EINE GROSSE BANK" Vertreter von Parteien über das ganze politische Spektrum hinweg sagten der Nachrichtenagentur Reuters, die Hürden für eine Abschwächung des 90-Prozent-Vorschlages seien hoch. Im Nationalrat sind die Parteien links der Mitte stärker vertreten als im Ständerat, und die Parteien der Mitte und des bürgerlichen Lagers sind entweder gespalten oder neigen zu einer härteren Linie. "Meine persönliche Einschätzung ist, dass der Nationalrat bei 90 Prozent landen könnte", sagte der FDP-Abgeordnete Olivier Feller, der selbst eine Absicherung der Auslandseinheiten der UBS mit 100 Prozent hartem Kernkapital befürwortet. "Wir sind ein kleines Land für eine große Bank." Die Haltung seiner Partei stehe noch nicht fest. Die UBS erklärte wiederholt, sie wolle in der Schweiz bleiben. Insidern zufolge arbeitet das Institut aber an [USN:L8N46126K TEXT:"Notfallplänen"], um auf ein mögliches ungünstiges Ergebnis der Parlamentsberatung reagieren zu können. Dazu gehören eine Verlegung des Hauptsitzes oder ein Zusammenschluss mit einem anderen Geldhaus. Experten halten einen Abschied der UBS aus Zürich dennoch für unwahrscheinlich. Die Stabilität und Rechtssicherheit der Schweiz seien heute nicht leicht zu finden, sagte der Zürcher Rechtsprofessor Urs Saxer. Die UBS werde daher nicht irrational handeln.

item.title: Rheinmetall übernimmt Werft in Rumänien
item.description: Der Rüstungskonzern Rheinmetall und die Schweizer Reederei MSC wollen die rumänische Mangalia-Werft südlich von Constanța übernehmen. Der Zuschlag sei im Rahmen einer Auktion erteilt worden, teilte der Düsseldorfer Konzern am Montag mit. Ziel sei der Aufbau eines Fertigungsstandorts sowohl für zivile als auch für militärische Schiffbauaktivitäten. Im Blick hätten die Partner den nationalen und internationalen Markt. Der Erwerb solle in einigen Wochen abgeschlossen sein. Der Kaufpreis betrage rund 138 Millionen Euro.

item.title: Bericht: In Zukunftsfeldern bis 2035 Investitionspotenzial im Billionen-Bereich
item.description: Die Wirtschaftsinitiative Made for Germany macht in fünf wichtigen Zukunftsfeldern bis 2035 ein Investitions- und Finanzierungspotenzial von 2,9 bis 4,1 Billionen Euro aus. Dies betreffe allein die Bereiche Künstliche Intelligenz in der Industrie, der Umbau der Industrie samt Zukunftstechnologien, widerstandsfähige Energiesysteme, die Kerninfrastruktur sowie der Bereich Sicherheit und Verteidigung. Das geht aus einem rund 60-seitigen Bericht der Initiative hervor, der am Montag veröffentlicht wurde und im Tagesverlauf an Wirtschaftsministerin Katherina Reiche (CDU) übergeben werden soll.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Die Wirtschaftsinitiative Made for Germany macht in fünf wichtigen Zukunftsfeldern bis 2035 ein Investitions- und Finanzierungspotenzial von 2,9 bis 4,1 Billionen Euro aus. Dies betreffe allein die Bereiche Künstliche Intelligenz in der Industrie, der Umbau der Industrie samt Zukunftstechnologien, widerstandsfähige Energiesysteme, die Kerninfrastruktur sowie der Bereich Sicherheit und Verteidigung. Das geht aus einem rund 60-seitigen Bericht der Initiative hervor, der am Montag veröffentlicht wurde und im Tagesverlauf an Wirtschaftsministerin Katherina Reiche (CDU) übergeben werden soll. Hinter Made for Germany stehen 147 Unternehmen und Investoren, darunter die Deutsche Bank und Siemens. Der Bericht richtet sich an Investoren aus dem In- und Ausland. Darin heißt es, die besten Argumente für den Standort Deutschland seien die politische und rechtliche Stabilität, eine exzellente Forschung, Top-Fachkräfte, eine tiefe industrielle Basis und der direkte EU-Marktzugang. Allerdings beklagen sich Unternehmen immer wieder über zu viel Bürokratie, zu hohe Steuern und Energiepreise sowie fehlende Reformen. Deswegen ist Deutschland in Standort-Rankings in den vergangenen Jahren abgerutscht.

item.title: UK luxury brand Mulberry posts 18% rise in first-half sales, shares gain
item.description: British luxury handbag maker Mulberry reported an 18% jump in first-half sales on Monday, driven by resilient demand for its heritage bags and a higher share of full-price sales, sending its shares nearly 4% higher in early trading.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: British luxury handbag maker Mulberry (MUL.L) reported an 18% jump in first-half sales on Monday, driven by resilient demand for its heritage bags and a higher share of full-price sales, sending its shares nearly 4% higher in early trading. The company said trading was in line with the board's expectations Mulberry maintained its medium-term goals after sales for the 26 weeks ended September 26 rose 18.2% in constant currency CEO Andrea Baldo's "[USN:L6N43O0C5 TEXT:"Back to the Mulberry Spirit"]" strategy has focused on the company's British heritage and craftsmanship and growing the brand with less discounting "The growth in full-price sales is particularly encouraging, demonstrating that our collections are resonating with customers across our key markets," Baldo said Shares of the company rose as much as 7.4% to 246 pence in early trade Sales growth was led by the US, where revenue rose 28%, while sales in Europe excluding the UK increased 23% UK sales were up 10% Mulberry's Christopher Kane London Fashion Week show boosted brand visibility, customer engagement and traffic across sales channels, the company said Final first-half results will be published on November 19

MOSCOW, Oct 19 (Reuters) – Russian President Vladimir Putin has backed a government reshuffle proposed by Prime Minister Mikhail Mishustin, state news agencies reported on Monday, citing the Kremlin.

“Along with a discussion on social and economic matters the prime minister proposed a number of personnel changes within the government to the head of state. These were endorsed by Putin,” Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov was quoted as saying by Russian news agencies.

The reshuffle follows a September parliamentary election which renewed the ranks of the State Duma lower house of parliament and comes as Russia is looking for new sources of growth amid a rising budget deficit, higher taxes and relatively high interest rates.

Show Full Article

The new ministers, who have not yet been publicly named, will be put forward for parliamentary approval, the Kremlin said, without giving further details.

Battle-hardened All Blacks find strength in depth ahead of World Cup

FAST

MELBOURNE, Oct 19 : Hard lessons from a brutal tour of South Africa appear to have paid off for Dave Rennie's All Blacks, with the team able to shrug off a litany of injuries and crush Australia in the Bledisloe Cup series. It will be a depleted New Zealand squad heading north for the final Nations Championship tests against England, Scotland and Wales, with outside back Leroy Carter added on Monday to the list of players staying home after having surgery on an ankle injury. Shannon Frizell (knee) and Samisoni Taukei’aho (calf) may also be sidelined after suffering injuries in the win in Sydney on Saturday. However, growing confidence in their squad depth a year out from the World Cup may outweigh the concerns.

Three successive defeats by world champions South Africa exposed shortcomings in Rennie's side but they now look stronger for the experience gained by fringe players and a return to form by veterans who had been written off. The benefits were evident in their second successive demolition of the Wallabies, a 43-21 triumph following their 50-19 stroll at Eden Park. The players unavailable for Sydney could have filled much of a starting 15, with Ardie Savea, Richie Mo'unga and Luke Jacobson among them. They lost Jordie Barrett before kick-off and Quinn Tupaea early with concussion, but there was little sign of disruption as the All Blacks ran in six first-half tries at Stadium Australia to all but kill off the game by the interval. “We’ve used 50-odd players this year, creating depth and competition for places. We’re missing a few influential players but other guys step up,” said Rennie.  With Savea and Jacobson missing, Peter Lakai and Wallace Sititi stood in at the back row with Tupou Vaa'i, the trio leaving the Wallabies' back three in the shade. The injury count has been a blessing for veterans Beauden Barrett and Damian McKenzie, with the former underlining his enduring value at fullback and the latter steering the All Blacks flawlessly at flyhalf in the absence of Ruben Love and Mo'unga. Les Kiss's Australia remain a work in progress a year out from hosting the World Cup but the core of the side that faced the All Blacks upset South Africa in Perth three weeks ago. The Wallabies had few answers for the All Blacks' try-scoring blitzes in the second half at Eden Park and the first at Stadium Australia. The Sydney win was another endorsement of Rennie's up-tempo attacking game, with New Zealand rediscovering the speed, ambition and clinical finishing that were hallmarks of their back-to-back World Cup wins in 2011 and 2015. "The Greatest Rivalry" tour of South Africa failed to live up to its billing but All Blacks fans may be glad to look back on it as a great turning point if further World Cup glory awaits. “We had an honest look at ourselves after the Greatest Rivalry,” stand-in All Blacks captain Codie Taylor said. “We walked away from that pretty gutted, also knowing we’re playing a brand of rugby we can be proud of and grow on."

item.title: アジア株式市場サマリー：引け（19日）
item.description: 中国株式市場は銀行株主導で上昇して引けた。好調な第３・四半期の国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）統計が、人工知能（ＡＩ）サプライチェー...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
アジア株式市場サマリー：引け（19日） 16:27 配信

中国株式市場は銀行株主導で上昇して引けた。好調な第３・四半期の国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）統計が、人工知能（ＡＩ）サプライチェーン関連の一部企業を巡る軟調なセンチメントを上回った。

香港市場は祝日のため休場で、取引は２０日に再開する。

中国の主要指数ＣＳＩ３００指数は０．１％高、上海総合指数は０．４％高で終了した。

中国の第３・四半期国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）は前年同期比４．５％増と、予想を上回った。これにより、年間成長率目標を達成するために政府が支援策を強化する緊急性は低下した。９月の小売売上高も伸びが加速した。

ＡＮＺはリポートで「９月の指標は予想外に良かったものの、２０２６年１─９月の実績を見れば、中国経済の不均衡に対する国内外の懸念はやはり強まった」と指摘。「バランスシート不況の圧力がかかる中、政策上の制約で金融緩和には限界があり、財政支援が引き続き極めて重要だ」とした。

銀行や酒類など伝統的なセクターが本土市場の上昇を主導し、それぞれ１．５％高、０．８％高となった。

ハイテク株中心の上海証券取引所の新興ハイテク企業向け市場「科創板」５０指数は２．２％下落。ＡＩチップのサプライチェーンを巡るセンチメントは引き続き軟調だった。

上場来安値を付けた人型ロボットメーカーのユニツリー（宇樹科技）は１６％急騰。一方、メモリー半導体メーカーの長鑫科技集団（ＣＸＭＴ）は７．８％下落した。

投資家の関心は、１９日午後に北京で開かれる重要な金融フォーラムに移っている。このフォーラムでは中国証券監督管理委員会（証監会）高官が講演する予定だ。

ソウル株式市場は、朝方の下げを取り戻して上昇して引けた。半導体株が、先週の大幅安を受けた押し目買いで反発した。

総合株価指数（ＫＯＳＰＩ）は前営業日終値比９９．９６ポイント（１．７６％）高の５７６８．０１で終了。

取引序盤には、前営業日の米ハイテク株急落を受け、同指数は３％超下落する場面もあった。

米国株式市場は１７日、大幅安で引けた。コアウィーブやブロードコムなど人工知能（ＡＩ）関連ハイテク株に再び売り圧力がかかったほか、原油価格の急騰が週末を控えたトレーダーの警戒感を高めた。

聯合ニュースによると、企画財政相は今年の経済成長率が３．４─３．６％に達する可能性があると述べた。

未来アセット証券のアナリスト氏は「先週の過度な下落を受けた押し目買いで相場は反発した。ただ、ＡＩを巡る不透明感が引き続き高い中、半導体株は他のセクターほど力強くはなかった」と指摘した。

サムスン電子は１．１６％高、同業のＳＫハイニックスは０．３９％高で引けた。

売買された全９１４銘柄のうち、上昇は６７７銘柄、下落は２０４銘柄だった。

海外投資家は差し引き３８１億ウォン（２８６４万ドル）相当を売り越した。

シドニー株式市場は続伸して引けた。金融株とエネルギー株が堅調に推移したほか、相次ぐ買収案件が株価指数を押し上げた。

Ｓ＆Ｐ／ＡＳＸ２００指数は０．４％高の８８４５．７０で終了し、９月９日以来の高値を付けた。

エネルギー株は一時２．２％上昇し９月中旬以来の高値を付けた。石炭採掘のニュー・ホープが非上場のマラバー・リソーシズを約２４億豪ドル（１６億７０００万米ドル）で買収することで合意、株価が６．４％急伸したことが寄与した。

同業大手のサントスは２．３％高、ウッドサイド・エナジーは２．７％高となった。

金融株指数は０．９％上昇。投資運用会社チャレンジャーが、第一ライフグループ傘下の企業から、未保有分の全株式を取得する買収提案を受けたと発表したことが相場を主導した。買収提案はチャレンジャーの企業価値を約７９億４０００万豪ドルと評価しており、同社株は１９．３％急騰して８年ぶりの高値で引けた。

一方、１６日に発表された統計では、８月の雇用者数が予想外に減少したことが示された。これを受け市場では、オーストラリア準備銀行（中央銀行）による１１月の利上げ観測が後退した。ただ、今後数カ月以内の利上げは引き続き予想されている。

ＫＣＭトレードのチーフマーケットアナリスト、ティム・ウォーターラー氏は「利上げ観測の後退は短期的に相場を支えるが、直近の上昇を踏まえると、バリュエーションや利ざやを巡るリスクは残っている。特に次回のインフレ指標が追加引き締めの可能性を再び浮上させた場合はそうだ」と指摘した。

他の買収案件では、クリーナウェイ・ウェイスト・マネジメントが２０．２％急伸。スウェーデンのプライベートエクイティ（ＰＥ）大手ＥＱＴによる９３億豪ドルでの買収に合意した。

フリートパートナーズは、パシフィック・エクイティ・パートナーズが支援するＳＧフリートによる１１億３０００万豪ドルでの買収に合意し、７．１％急騰した。

一方、ハイテク株は１．３％下落し、相場の上値を抑えた。多額の債務を抱える人工知能（ＡＩ）インフラ企業が、債務返済に間に合うように利益を上げられない可能性があるとの懸念から、米ハイテク株が軟調に推移した流れを引き継いだ。

item.title: BoE looks into claim Barclays private credit exposure misrepresented, FT reports
item.description: The Bank of England is examining whether Barclays traders misrepresented illiquid private credit loans to understate their risk after an insider at the British bank raised concerns, the Financial Times reported on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Bank of England is examining whether Barclays (BARC.L) traders misrepresented illiquid private credit loans to understate their risk after an insider at the British bank raised concerns, the Financial Times reported on Monday. The report, which cited people familiar with the matter, said that the Prudential Regulation Authority received a complaint earlier this year about how Barclays was recording derivatives used to finance private credit loans. The Band of England declined to comment on the report. The complaint centred on Barclays’ allocation of total return swaps referencing illiquid private credit loans to its trading book, the FT report said, without disclosing an amount for it. Barclays shares were down 2.6% to 421.4 pence at 0750 GMT on Monday, while the FTSE 100 (.FTSE) index was 0.9% lower. "Barclays takes seriously its regulatory obligations in markets where it operates," the bank said in an emailed statement to Reuters. It declined to comment further on its interactions with the regulator. The FT said the complaint also alleged that the way Barclays handled the deals was in breach of the PRA's rules, which restrict banks from assigning derivatives backed by illiquid collateral to their trading book, unless they can supply enough evidence to justify the treatment. The regulatory concern is that classifying derivatives linked to illiquid loans as easier-to-trade investments could understate the risk of the underlying exposure and reduce the amount of money required to be set aside for potential losses. The FT report said Barclays traders argued the exposure should be treated as a traded position because it was hedged through a matching swap with another counterparty, despite being linked to illiquid private credit loans.

item.title: World Food Programme cuts aid to 500,000 Palestinians in Gaza, citing funding shortages
item.description: The UN World Food Programme has said funding shortages are forcing major cuts to its aid programme in Gaza, leaving about 500,000 people without monthly food support in a territory where two-thirds of the population struggle to get enough to eat.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The UN World Food Programme has said funding shortages are forcing major cuts to its aid programme in Gaza, leaving about 500,000 people without monthly food support in a territory where two-thirds of the population struggle to get enough to eat. The WFP said it was reducing the number of recipients of its monthly assistance to 1.1 million people from 1.6 million. In addition, food rations have been halved, cash assistance has been cut for 75,000 families, and the number of daily hot meals for those unable to cook has fallen to 150,000 from 250,000, with some families in hard-to-reach areas now receiving a hot meal only every other day. The WFP said about 1.4 million people, or two-thirds of Gaza's population, face crisis levels of food insecurity or worse, including roughly 200,000 people in emergency conditions. Last year's US-brokered Gaza [USN:L1N45Y057 TEXT:"ceasefire"] calls for the eventual reconstruction of the territory. But little progress has been made towards implementing a deal to end the conflict that includes terms for Hamas to disarm and Israel to withdraw its troops. "It's a year into the agreement of this ceasefire. Well, life is still brutal here. There is no proper shelter.. There is no basic services. There is no safety, no security," acting Executive Director of the World Food Program WFP Carl Skau told Reuters in Gaza. "These cuts are happening just as we are facing the fourth winter. You know, I've been through the winters here, absolutely brutal," he added. The WFP said it urgently needs $450 million over the next six months to maintain critical operations in Gaza and the Israeli-occupied West Bank. "We tell the world now is this is not the time to look away. This is the time to step up to sustain this support, to protect the progress that has been made, but also to push for early recovery," said Skau.

item.description: [東京 １９日 ロイター] - 高市早苗首相は１９日の参院予算委員会で、消費税減税の財源確保に関し、具体像については予算編成プロセスで確実に示す考えを示した上で、岸田文雄内閣で防衛費捻出のために本来は外国為替資金特別会計
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[東京 １９日 ロイター] - 高市早苗首相は１９日の参院予算委員会で、消費税減税の財源確保に関し、具体像については予算編成プロセスで確実に示す考えを示した上で、岸田文雄内閣で防衛費捻出のために本来は外国為替資金特別会計 （外為特会）に留保すべき剰余金を活用した事例や、過去５年で税収が３０兆円以上も上振れたことなどを列挙し、「必要な財政需要に対応できるということはお分かりかと思う」と語った。

山添拓委員（共産）への答弁。

２０２７年度末の残高が７兆円に上る見込みの基金のうち不要な長期の滞留資金を国庫に返納し、今年度９兆円程度の税外収入のうち約６兆円の使途の定めのないものについても上積みを検討することも例示した。近年の多額の物価高対策も見直すとした。

消費減税の財源は特例公債に頼らない方針を繰り返すと同時に、予算編成改革という大きな枠組みの中で歳出、歳入両面の見直しを進める考えを改めて示した。「国債発行額を適切にコントロールしながら、（消費減税）だけではなくさまざまな必要な財政需要に確実に対応する」と強調した。

FAST

TOKYO, Oct 19 : Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi said on Monday she would not rule out the chance of issuing bonds to fund a two-year cut to the country's consumption tax scheduled from April next year. The government will seek to stably lower the ratio of debt balance to gross domestic product (GDP) by reviewing both spending and expenditure, Takaichi told parliament. "As we do this, we will appropriately control the size of annual bond issuance," she said. "We would not rule out the chance of issuing bonds altogether," Takaichi said, highlighting how the government could raise proceeds to fund the scheduled sales tax cut. Takaichi also said Japan can heighten market trust in the yen by pursuing steps to strengthen the economy. The government has laid out a plan to cut an 8 per cent levy on food items from April next year, as part of efforts to cushion the blow to households from rising living costs.

item.title: European shares slip on French unrest; earnings in focus
item.description: French equities led losses in Europe on Monday after one of the worst bouts of protest violence in years over the weekend, while broader sentiment was subdued ahead of a busy week of earnings.
item.dc:creator: Avinash P
item.content:encoded: French equities led losses in Europe on Monday after one of the [USN:L1N46401W TEXT:"worst bouts of protest violence"] in years over the weekend, while broader sentiment was subdued ahead of a busy week of earnings. The blue-chip CAC 40 index (.FCHI) fell 1.38% after nationwide protests triggered by rising prices and worsening public services rocked the euro zone's second-largest economy as it grapples with weak growth and rising debt. The unrest, which adds to political uncertainty ahead of the presidential election in 2027 and tests investor resilience, pressured [USN:L1N46507D TEXT:"French government bonds"]. "There is clearly political risk and that is going to mean you get near-term volatility," said Kiran Ganesh, a multi-asset strategist at UBS Global Wealth Management. "There's a range of factors beyond the protests, which are probably more important for the medium and longer term picture." French lenders BNP Paribas (BNPP.PA) , Societe Generale (SOGN.PA) and Credit Agricole (CAGR.PA) fell between 2.2% and 2.6%. Retailer Carrefour (CARR.PA) declined 1.9% and shopping mall operator Unibail-Rodamco-Westfield (URW.PA) declined 2%. The pan-European STOXX 600 index (.STOXX) was down 0.79% at 639.63 points by 0913 GMT after climbing more than 2% the previous week, its best week since late June, as European shares held up better than US peers during a selloff in AI-linked stocks over concerns about rising debt to fund infrastructure. Cyclical sectors led declines, with defence stocks (.SXPARO) among the biggest losers, while banks (.SX7E) also came under pressure. Spain's benchmark (.IBEX) fell 1.34%, weighed down by declines in bank stocks. A snap election scheduled for next month has also added to political uncertainty in the euro zone. Spain's hard-left parties on Saturday [USN:L8N46305T TEXT:"presented"] separate candidate lists for a snap election, reducing Socialist Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez's chances of staying in power at the head of a leftist coalition. Investors were also eyeing earnings from European and US blue-chip companies to help risk appetite after the AI-linked stocks selloff last week. Software maker SAP (SAPG.DE) , British lender Barclays (BARC.L) and telecom equipment maker Nokia (NOKIA.HE) are scheduled to report later this week. In the US, results from Meta Platforms (META.O) and chip firms will be will be scrutinised for signs of AI demand and spending trends that could provide fresh direction for equity markets. Among individual movers, Norway's Mowi (MOWI.OL) gained 3.8% after the salmon producer's third-quarter harvest volumes hit an all-time high.

item.title: Rubio denies US paused intelligence sharing with Ukraine
item.description: Rubio contradicted Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy.
item.dc:creator: Gram Slattery
item.content:encoded: Secretary of State Marco Rubio denied on Monday that the United States had paused some intelligence sharing with Ukraine, contradicting Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy who said Washington had briefly done just that. Speaking to NBC's Meet the Press [USN:L6N46405N TEXT:"on Sunday"], Zelenskiy had said intelligence sharing had been interrupted, but later "de-blocked." "We are very thankful for this," he said. "Now it works." But Rubio, speaking to reporters during a visit to Uzbekistan on Monday morning, said intelligence was in fact never interrupted in the first place. "I don't know where he's getting these things or why he's saying these things to the press. You should go back and ask him. There's been no pause," Rubio told reporters after touring Registan Square, a historic complex of madrassas in Samarkand. "What he should be focused on, and what we want to be focused on, is bringing an end to this war. That's what he should be focused on," Rubio said of Zelenskiy. It was the latest twist in a confusing several days during which Washington and Kyiv have [USN:L6N46303A TEXT:"contradicted"] each other on more than one occasion and relations between the countries have deteriorated sharply. Zelenskiy has also said he believes the US government was behind recent limits on Ukraine's ability to use the [USN:L1N4620L4 TEXT:"Starshield"] system, designed by SpaceX, which is crucial to defending against Russian drones and missiles. US officials have denied those assertions as well. Ukraine has relied on US intelligence to spot the fast-moving ballistic missiles that Russia has fired in waves at its cities. President Donald Trump had said earlier this week that Washington was still sharing intelligence, although Ukrainian officials said some Russian strikes had occurred without warning, raising questions about whether the intelligence was in fact flowing as normal.

item.title: 日経平均は反落、米コアウィーブ警戒が継続 下値では押し目買いも
item.description:
Noriyuki Hirata
[東京 １９日 ロイター] - 東京株式市場で日経平均は反落し、前営業日比０．６２％（...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
日経平均は反落、米コアウィーブ警戒が継続　下値では押し目買いも 16:12 配信

2026年4月6日、東京証券取引所内を歩く訪問者ら。REUTERS/Issei Kato

Noriyuki Hirata

[東京 １９日 ロイター] - 東京株式市場で日経平均は反落し、前営業日比０．６２％（４０７円５９銭）安の６万４９１６円７０銭で取引を終えた。前週末の米国株式市場で新興クラウドのコアウィーブ株が急落したことを嫌気してＡＩ（人工知能）株安となる中、週明けの東京市場では朝方から関連株の売りが優勢だった。一時節目の６万４０００円を割り込んで１カ月ぶり安値に下落する場面があったが、次第に押し目買いが入り、引けにかけて下げを縮めた。ＴＯＰＩＸは小高く終えた。

前週末の米国市場でコアウィーブ株が再び急落し、フィラデルフィア半導体指数（ＳＯＸ）が３．８％安となったことが、国内関連株の逆風になった。米標準油種ＷＴＩ先物が一時１００ドル台に上昇したことも投資家の慎重姿勢につながった。

アドバンテストやソフトバンクグループといったＡＩ・半導体関連株が軟調となり、日経平均は一時２．２８％（１４９２円５１銭）安の６万３８３１円７８銭と約１カ月ぶりの安値を付けた。原油高によるインフレ懸念は、景気敏感株の重しになった。

その後、日経平均は下値で押し目買いが入り、午後にかけて下げを縮めた。時間外取引の米株先物や韓国ＫＯＳＰＩの堅調推移が投資家心理の支えになった。キオクシアホールディングスはプラスだった。

直近の株安は、コアウィーブのＣＤＳ（クレジット・デフォルト・スワップ）スプレッドが急拡大する中、ハイパースケーラーの資金調達環境も悪化しかねないとの警戒が浮上していたことが一因となってきたが、下げ渋る形となり「（コアウィーブとハイパースケーラーとでは）稼ぐ力が異なるという認識が広がってきているのではないか」（東京海上アセットマネジメントの若山哲志株式運用部シニアファンドマネージャー）との声があった。

目先は企業決算や日米の中銀会合、米中間選挙とイベントが相次ぐ。これらをこなす中で「ファンダメンタルズが崩れていないと確認されれば、（この数日の株安は）ポジション調整にすぎなかったという整理になるのではないか」（若山氏）との見方も聞かれた。

ＴＯＰＩＸは０．０４％高の４０６７．４８ポイントで取引を終えた。東証プライム市場指数は前営業日比０．０３％高の２０９６．２７ポイントだった。プライム市場の売買代金は６兆７８３５億８０００万円だった。東証３３業種で上昇したのは、鉱業、海運、石油・石炭の２１業種、下落は非鉄金属、電気機器、繊維の１２業種。

ＩＮＰＥＸが大幅高。前週に決算を発表したベイカレントやＳＨＩＦＴが引き続き買われた。一方、メルカリや高島屋は軟調だった。新興株式市場は、東証グロース市場２５０指数が反落し、１．５７％安の７６６．９１ポイントだった。

東証プライム市場の騰落数は、値上がりが６２１銘柄（４０％）、値下がりは８７３銘柄（５６％）、変わらずは５８銘柄（３％）だった。

item.title: Polish satellite maker Creotech plans tenfold capacity boost, warns of Europe’s US rocket reliance
item.description: Polish satellite maker Creotech Instruments plans to raise its production capacity by up to tenfold by 2029, CEO Grzegorz Brona said on Friday, while warning Europe would remain reliant on US rockets to put its satellites into orbit for years.
item.dc:creator: Stefan Gardawski, Marta Maciag
item.content:encoded: Polish satellite maker Creotech Instruments (CRI1.WA) plans to raise its production capacity by up to tenfold by 2029, CEO Grzegorz Brona said on Friday, while warning Europe would remain reliant on US rockets to put its satellites into orbit for years. Brona spoke with Reuters in Sopot two days after Ukraine said SpaceX (SPCX.O) had [USN:L8N4600M6 TEXT:"curbed its use of Starshield"], the military-grade version of the Starlink satellite network. Shares of Eutelsat (ETL.PA) , widely seen as Europe's leading challenger to Starlink, [USN:L8N4620IW TEXT:"jumped 23%"] on Wednesday and closed the week 28% higher. Asked whether European industry could build an alternative to Starlink, Brona said the continent could produce thousands of satellites and still have no one to launch them. "Launch vehicles are now becoming a means of political pressure on the European Union in the hands of (US President) Donald Trump's administration," he said. Europe carried out 8 of the world's 324 orbital launches last year, against 193 by the US. Starlink alone accounted for more than 60% of active satellites, according to European Space Agency data. Creotech, which does not build rockets, has kept US technology out of its satellites to avoid US arms export rules, under which Washington can block sales of a satellite containing even a small American part. Yet it still relies on US rockets. SpaceX carried all four satellites Creotech built for Poland's MikroGlob military programme into orbit. "Of course, Europe is waking up," Brona said, pointing to new European rocket programmes including a [USN:L1N44Y01P TEXT:"German launcher"], but added that building enough rockets would probably take a decade. Separately, he said [USN:L8N3YS0MG TEXT:"programmes"] for several large EU satellite constellations — fleets of spacecraft working as one system — were already under way, and that Creotech aimed to bid in their tenders. The satellite maker plans to open a factory in 2029 able to make 40 satellites a year of mixed types, or up to 100 of one model, compared with about 10 at its current plant. Brona added Creotech would start opening subsidiaries in France and Germany in the coming weeks and was aiming to build 500-kg satellites by 2032. Revenue for next year is secured, and the company will probably sign several more contracts within six months, Brona said.

item.title: US drone firm Red Cat seeks control of Austria's Steyr Motors in $230 million deal
item.description: Austrian engine and engine parts manufacturer Steyr Motors said on Monday that US drone maker Red Cat Holdings plans to acquire the company in a deal valued at about €204.8 million ($230 million).
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Austrian engine and engine parts manufacturer Steyr Motors (4X0.VI) said on Monday that US drone maker Red Cat Holdings (RCAT.O) plans to acquire the company in a deal valued at about €204.8 million ($230 million). Red Cat intends to launch a voluntary takeover offer for all Steyr shares at €39 per share in cash, a 28.9% premium to the stock's last closing price. Shares in Steyr jumped 20%, on track for the best day since March 2025. B&C Holding Österreich, which owns about 15% of Steyr Motors, has agreed to tender its stake, Steyr said. The transaction is subject to conditions, including foreign direct investment approvals and a minimum acceptance threshold of 50% plus one share, with Red Cat expecting to complete the acquisition in the first half of 2027. Steyr CEO Julian Cassutti said he intends to tender his own shares as well. Steyr Supervisory Board Chairman Rolf Wirtz said the board sees strategic potential in the proposed combination ($1 = €0.8910)

item.title: Cherry or tabasco? Perfumers test weight-loss drug users' appetite for food-inspired scents
item.description: From cherry and banoffee pie to tabasco and sesame, the list of food aromas popping up in luxury fragrances keeps growing. Now some perfume makers are starting to ask if weight-loss drugs might be reshaping what consumers want in a scent.
item.dc:creator: Alexander Marrow, Denis Balibouse
item.content:encoded: From cherry and banoffee pie to tabasco and sesame, the list of food aromas popping up in luxury fragrances keeps growing. Now some perfume makers are starting to ask if weight-loss drugs might be reshaping what consumers want in a scent. (This is the first story in a five-part Reuters series on how weight-loss drugs are changing the way people shop and eat, and how companies are responding to the trend.) So-called gourmand fragrances like Thierry Mugler's pioneering cotton candy-inspired Angel and Nina Ricci's toffee apple scent Nina have been around for decades. More recent growth in the segment has been attributed to the pandemic-era boom in online retail — when familiar food associations helped sales of perfumes that cannot be smelled before purchase — and the growing prominence of Gen Z consumers. But as scent makers experiment with more novel flavour aromas, Reuters conversations with eight fragrance manufacturers and top perfume brands revealed how they are assessing GLP-1 users' responses to these food-linked smells. Givaudan (GIVN.S) and IFF (IFF.N) , two of the world's largest flavour and fragrance houses, British-owned scent maker CPL Aromas and French cosmetics giant L'Oreal (OREP.PA) all said they have explored the link between the increasingly popular drugs and scent preferences. All four companies, as well as four scientists Reuters spoke to, stressed that more research was needed. RESEARCH SUGGESTS GLP-1 USERS SEEK PLEASURE IN SCENTS Common negative side effects of GLP-1 weight-loss drugs like Novo Nordisk's (NOVOb.CO) Wegovy and Eli Lilly's (LLY.N) Mounjaro include nausea and gastrointestinal issues. Researchers are also looking at other potential effects, some unexpected, including a reduction in alcohol cravings or urges to gamble and impulse-shop, and changes to smell and taste. "(GLP-1 drugs having) a chemosensory effect is not a far-fetched idea," said Paule Joseph, co-director of the National Smell and Taste Center at the US National Institutes of Health. As GLP-1 drugs reshape appetite, they also affect the tissue of the olfactory bulb that processes odour, although Joseph said it was too early to predict how, or even if, that might impact odour perception. Research conducted by IFF suggests GLP-1 therapies may spark a greater interest in scent as a source of sensory pleasure, said Celine Manetta, health and wellness director, R&D, at IFF Scent. IFF is already using such insights to identify notes and produce fragrances that evoke emotional responses, she said. L'Oreal, observing findings that show GLP-1 users crave pleasure, fragrances and scents, has drawn similar conclusions. "They compensate for the pleasure of food, or pleasure of taste, with other forms of enjoyment," said L’Oreal Paris' Global Brand President Laetitia Toupet. Givaudan has been studying the possible link for around a year, said Arnaud Guggenbuhl, the Swiss firm's global head of marketing for fine fragrance. GLP-1 use can alter fragrance preferences, he said, with some beloved smells suddenly repellent while other scents become appealing. The overall trend, the company found, was an increase in interest in fragrance and perfume. Givaudan is now expanding its gourmand offering, creating fragrances that reproduce the layered scent of cakes like banoffee, panettone and cupcakes. "You can have the crispy part, the tarty part, the milky part and the creamy part," Guggenbuhl said. "The full fragrance smells like a true cake." STILL ENJOYING WHAT YOU CAN'T EAT Unlike manufacturers, which develop the scents used as ingredients in perfumes, fragrance brand owners like Puig (PUIGb.MC) and Coty (COTY.N) are generally not researching the possible GLP-1 link. But they are keenly attuned to what is happening in the market — both in terms of growth trends and shifts in taste — and are taking steps to adapt. Over 1 billion people globally are now obese, according to the World Health Organization. That provides an enormous pool of potential customers for weight-loss drugs. Pharmaceutical companies and analysts predict the GLP-1 market may be worth up to $150 billion by 2030. That could also mean a bigger perfume market. Gourmet and edible is now the second-largest fragrance group for product innovation behind floral scents, said Clotilde Drape, global beauty analyst at market analysis agency Mintel, with its share having risen to 24% over the last year from 9% two years earlier. A study of GLP-1 users in the US by market researcher NIQ, meanwhile, found they spent 26% more on fragrances than the typical person. "GLP-1 users are overall more invested in beauty, as they spend more across most categories," said Anna Mayo, NIQ's vice president of beauty and personal care thought leadership. Both Coty and Puig expect traditional vanilla-based scents, such as Burberry's (BRBY.L) Goddess perfume and Yves Saint Laurent's Libre Eau de Parfum, to remain popular. But other edible notes are becoming more prominent, they told Reuters. "There has been a more sophisticated, more adult evolution. There are now many different notes available on the market: boozy, whisky, rum, tequila," said Gregorio Sola, senior perfumer and creative director at Puig. Perfumers are also incorporating spicy components like tabasco and bitter notes of cocoa. Gen Z consumers in particular are seeking savoury, salty fermented and roasted aromas over sweetness, said Nelly Di Mercurio, global marketing and communications director at CPL Aromas. Sesame, miso, rice, truffle and even matcha-based fragrances were also emerging, she said. And Jean Holtzmann, chief brands officer for Coty's prestige division, pointed to new combinations of vanilla with nuts like pistachio. "The next generation of gourmand is ... about taste and texture rather than just being sweet," he said. Givaudan's Guggenbuhl, for his part, believes creaminess — banana, whipped cream and warm milk — will be the next trend to sweep the market. But regardless of the flavour, with GLP-1 users set to remain a driving force, he sees no letup in the expansion of gourmand fragrances. "What they cannot eat anymore, they still want to enjoy."

item.title: Spain's rush to clear Ceuta migrant backlog raises rights concerns
item.description: When heavily pregnant Fatna and her disabled son arrived in Spain's North African enclave of Ceuta during a chaotic mass border crossing on July 30, she hoped to be high on authorities' list for help.
item.dc:creator: Corina Pons, Victoria Waldersee
item.content:encoded: When heavily pregnant Fatna and her disabled son arrived in Spain's North African enclave of Ceuta during a [USN:L8N44F14U TEXT:"chaotic mass border crossing"] on July 30, she hoped to be high on authorities' list for help. Nearly three months later, with her newborn baby girl suffering from kidney problems, Fatna, 21, and her family urgently need to reach mainland Spain for specialist hospital treatment. However, travelling while her asylum claim is under review requires a permit that Spain's socialist government – ordinarily a staunch advocate of immigration – has been reluctant to grant to any of the thousands of migrants remaining in Ceuta. Some are still scattered on the streets or hiding in the rolling hills of the tiny 20-sq-km port city on Morocco's northeast border. Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez's government is under pressure from the EU and an increasingly frustrated populace to sort out the crisis and faces [USN:L8N45R05N TEXT:"a snap election"] on November 29. It is working on shortcuts for asylum applications with the intention of sending most people home, mainly to Morocco, on the basis of being economic migrants not real asylum-seekers. That, NGOs fear, risks violating migrants' rights. Sanchez, one of Europe's few remaining left-leaning leaders, said this week that Spain was managing the flood of cases "responsibly, with a sense of solidarity and respecting migrants' human rights". But more than 20 interviews by Reuters with migrants, lawyers, NGOs, and security forces revealed that many of those who remain have clear grounds for asylum or humanitarian protection: from unaccompanied minors to LGBT Moroccans fearing imprisonment if deported and families like Fatna's classified as vulnerable under EU law. Last week, eight charities including Oxfam and Amnesty International filed a complaint with Spain's ombudsman seen by Reuters alleging "grave rights violations" in the tiny Ceuta enclave. They included the forced return of migrants from conflict-hit countries and denial of interpreters and legal assistance. Spokespeople for Spain's central government, interior ministry, territorial policy ministry and migration ministry did not respond to Reuters requests for comment on the mistreatment accusations. "There are people who will truly be in enormous danger if they are returned to Morocco," said Wendell Soares, coordinator of the Catholic migrant reception centre San Antonio which has taken in Fatna's family and dozens more vulnerable people, far beyond its usual capacity of seven. "When the word ‘immigrant’ is used, it creates a collective image, as if they were all the same. Every person has their own story." DEPORTED WITHOUT EXPLANATION Spanish right-wing and far-right parties were already angry with Sanchez's government for [USN:L8N42N0Y2 TEXT:"providing legal status"] to nearly 1 million irregular migrants earlier this year. They have cast July's crossing as a deliberate invasion by Morocco – an accusation Morocco denies – and demanded that all migrants be returned . But despite plans for a [USN:S8N4150LX TEXT:"new EU-wide procedure"] enabling accelerated deportations in future emergency scenarios, current rules require that migrants be assessed case-by-case. While most are from Morocco, the government estimated in August that more than 1,000 of the migrants remaining were from sub-Saharan countries whose nationals are granted asylum in over 90% of cases in Spain, according to government statistics. The EU's [USN:L8N42J0LA TEXT:"new pact"] requires that cases be processed in border zones to permit faster deportations. But it does not require applicants to stay where they arrived, allowing for transfers to other border zones in Spain that would alleviate pressure on the 84,000-person enclave of Ceuta, Europe's only land border with Africa. If vulnerable migrants' cases are to be properly assessed, such transfers are the "only option", said Juan Miguel Morales, director-general of NGO Sur Acoge. While 262 minors have been transferred to the Spanish mainland since the July crossing, the government's strategy for the remaining adults has been to convince as many as possible to return of their own volition. The government said this week that 12,000 had chosen to cross back since mid-August. "There are no covert deportations under any circumstances," Interior Minister Fernando Grande-Marlaska said, describing the returns as voluntary and adding that up to 1,200 asylum applications had been received and 700 of them resolved. However, at least nine NGOs have in public communication or interviews with Reuters claimed that migrants they support were coerced to return. Asociación Elin said migrants from Sudan and Chad were summoned by police on September 24 and 25 and deported without warning, according to the complaint to the ombudsman. In text messages reviewed by Reuters, Moroccan migrant Azhaar Chaouni told volunteers at German NGO Mission Lifeline that he and other migrants faced the same fate, after being picked up in buses by police from their makeshift camps on the beach and told they were being taken to reception centres. "They deported us without explanation," Chaouni wrote, saying he was in Morocco. Morocco's designation as a "safe country of origin" under EU rules does not strip its citizens of the right to apply for asylum, said Andrea de Petris, immigration expert at Brussels-based think tank CEPN. "Each individual must be guaranteed a specific assessment of their personal circumstances," added De Petris who estimates the procedure would inevitably be "lengthy and costly". Stories of others disappearing have instilled fear in Rayane, a 19-year-old gay Moroccan awaiting news on his asylum application in the San Antonio reception centre. Rejected by his family and unable to live openly in Morocco where same-sex sexual acts are prosecuted, he is desperate to get to mainland Europe. "I can’t even imagine myself going back to Morocco. I’d kill myself before even crossing the border," he said. PACT EXPOSED Frontline workers and NGOs on the ground say the situation in Ceuta has proven that the 12-week limit set in the EU’s migrant pact for processing asylum applications is unrealistic, with seven stating they expect the process to drag on for months. A lack of resources from staff to functioning computers meant that only around 100 migrants' cases were being registered daily by October 14, according to police union representative Raul Piera. The union estimates roughly 7,000-8,000 more migrants are still scattered across the city, sleeping rough or squeezed into facilities provided by charities and civil society groups filling the gap left by Ceuta's overwhelmed social services. "Looking at the remaining workload, this will last well into next summer," said Piera. Spain's government has declined to comment on estimates of unregistered migrants, with Territorial Policy Minister Angel Victor Torres telling reporters on October 14 that it was impossible to know how many were hiding. Doctors in Ceuta's only hospital are treating migrants for scabies, tuberculosis and gastrointestinal infections caused by long periods outdoors, said Enrique Robiralta, head of the doctors' union. At least seven women have given birth. Fatna and her husband Mohamed are desperate to stay in Spain, fearing for the new baby and convinced their 3-year-old disabled son will die in Morocco. "We are doing everything for our son," said Mohamed.

item.title: Philippines summons China's envoy over remarks conveying 'threat'
item.description: The Philippine foreign ministry on Monday summoned China's ambassador to express its "serious concern and strong objection" about remarks by the envoy that it said conveyed a threat of the use of force.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Philippine foreign ministry on Monday summoned China's ambassador to express its "serious concern and strong objection" about remarks by the envoy that it said conveyed a [USN:L6N46203B TEXT:"threat"] of the use of force. Ambassador Jing Quan told media last week that China "may easily win" in a confrontation with the Philippines, but Beijing would not use force because "we love peace". He was responding to a question about the Philippine defence secretary describing China as a regional troublemaker. Philippine Foreign Secretary Ma. Theresa Lazaro told Jing that his comments were "provocative and unacceptable" and aggravated the sensitive atmosphere between the two countries, the Department of Foreign Affairs said in a statement. Sensitive issues should be addressed through established diplomatic channels and bilateral mechanisms that reserve space for dialogue and engagement, she said. Diplomatic squabbles between China and the Philippines, a US ally, have become more frequent in recent years, typically over standoffs and altercations between rival vessels in the South China Sea, much of which Beijing claims sovereignty over. Manila has accused China's coast guard of aggressive conduct in the Philippines' exclusive economic zone, while Beijing insists it is enforcing the law against vessels that are encroaching on its territory. Asked about the summoning and calls by some lawmakers in Manila for Jing's expulsion, China said on Monday it firmly opposes what it called the "malicious hyping" of China-related issues by some individuals. "The Philippine side should take concrete steps to restrain such irresponsible words and actions by certain politicians," China's foreign ministry spokesperson Mao Ning told a daily press conference. Mao also said that improving bilateral relations would benefit both countries. China's embassy in Manila last week said Jing had been selectively quoted and his remarks overinterpreted.

item.title: ベトナム中銀、商銀に貸出金利引き下げ指示 不動産市場圧迫で
item.description: [１９日 ロイター] - ベトナム国家銀行（中央銀行）は商業銀行に対し、企業向け貸出金利を引き下げるよう指示した。住宅...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ベトナム中銀、商銀に貸出金利引き下げ指示　不動産市場圧迫で 15:55 配信

写真はベトナム国家銀行（中央銀行）本店。2024年11月、ベトナム・ハノイで撮影。REUTERS/Khanh Vu

[１９日 ロイター] - ベトナム国家銀行（中央銀行）は商業銀行に対し、企業向け貸出金利を引き下げるよう指示した。住宅ローン金利の上昇が、経済成長の主要なけん引役である不動産市場を圧迫していることが背景。

・１８日付の通達で、重点分野向けの貸出金利を年率で１．５─２％ポイント引き下げるよう銀行に指示した。

・また、期間６カ月以上の預金の公示金利を少なくとも０．５％ポイント引き下げ、預金者により高い金利を提示する競争をやめるよう求めた。

・さらに、金利に関する政府や中銀の指示に従わない銀行に対し、規制要件の厳格化や２０２７年の融資増加率の上限引き下げなどの措置を講じる可能性があると警告した。

・このほか、融資基準を緩和することなく、生産活動や重点分野、実行可能な主要プロジェクトに融資を振り向けるよう指示した。

・一連の措置について、安定の維持、インフレ抑制、銀行システムの保護を図りつつ経済成長を支援する狙いと説明した。

・不動産サービス会社サヴィルズによると、首都ハノイの第３・四半期のマンション販売は前四半期比２６％減、前年同期比４８％減となった。中古市場の価格は３四半期連続で下落した。

・サヴィルズのアドバイザリーサービス部門責任者、ド・ティ・トゥ・ハン氏は「住宅ローン金利の上昇が、市場を圧迫する要因の一つとなっている」と述べた。

item.title: Putin approves minor Russian government reshuffle
item.description: Russian President Vladimir Putin on Monday backed what looked like a fairly minor government reshuffle proposed by Prime Minister Mikhail Mishustin.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Russian President Vladimir Putin on Monday backed what looked like a fairly minor government reshuffle proposed by Prime Minister Mikhail Mishustin. The reshuffle follows a September parliamentary election which renewed the ranks of the State Duma lower house of parliament and comes as Russia is looking for new sources of growth amid a rising budget deficit, higher taxes and relatively high interest rates. In one of the most notable changes, Anton Siluanov will now serve as a deputy prime minister in addition to remaining finance minister, a portfolio he has held since 2011. In other changes, Transport Minister Andrei Nikitin was nominated to become a deputy prime minister overseeing, among other areas, the development of the transport sector. Dmitry Yadrov, head of Russia's Federal Air Transport Agency (Rosaviatsiya), was nominated to succeed Nikitin as transport minister. All the changes are subject to parliamentary approval.

item.description: Der Anteil von Frauen in Top-Jobs bleibt in Deutschland deutlich unter dem EU-Durchschnitt.
